segments.name: cavetto
segments.note: CFB-A02: the inverted quarter circle, VISIBLE + period definition. The ledger's v3 builder realizes it as a kappa cubic (C1=(K*R,R), C2=(R,K*R)); here it is the true circle with centre and direction DECLARED - the arc-bowed-the-wrong-way defect that cost the ledger three repair passes is unrepresentable in this form

notes: STATUS: independent cross-check of the approved GOK001-CFB geometry through the SINC_GeometryProof_Profile system - it does NOT discharge GOK001-CFB-P04, whose no-advance rule requires the ledger's own v3 builder (work/build_gok001_profile_cavetto_fillet_b_v1.py) to run directly, reopen, and pass its six disproof views.
Fully normalized (units relative, R = 1.000): demonstrates the relative-proportion boundary the ledger mandates, with zero code changes to the proof system.

Solid side is LEFT of the COUNTERCLOCKWISE traversal (E00 down the outer land, around the cove, up the closure) even though the cavetto member itself is a CLOCKWISE arc - outline winding and member direction are independent facts, and the compiler rejected the first draft of this spec for declaring them inconsistently. The open cove space at the origin quadrant is void, per CFB-A04's constraint.
Evidence mapping from the ledger vocabulary: REFERENCE_INFERRED -> ESTIMATED, VISIBLE/period definition -> DERIVED, PROJECT_DECISION -> AUTHORED; original labels preserved in per-item notes.
